name: parrot
description: The Energy fleet's internationalization (i18n / l10n) domain-expert employee as one installable Claude Code plugin: bundles the `parrot` CLI, the `parrot` stdio MCP server, the six i18n skills, the i18n-string-gate hook, and the two sub-agent personas. Install to wire next-intl into a Next.js app the first time (the 4 load-bearing files, proxy.ts on Next 16, setRequestLocale everywhere), find hardcoded user-facing strings, author/lint ICU MessageFormat plurals, audit RTL/bidi as a layout job, validate the hreflang graph, run governed machine-translation, and gate i18n correctness in CI — always testing the 20% that English-only testing never catches (pl/ar/he plurals + RTL + format), never the words themselves. Boundary (HARD, brain P29): i18n plumbing + grammar engine + routing + CI gate ONLY — parrot wires the pipeline that carries and gates the strings, it NEVER authors the copy (marketing/docs/prose, brand voice, human translation of long-form text → content employee / human translator). Powered by Energy.

hook.name: i18n-string-gate
hook.description: Parse-time block of parrot's own law: a hardcoded multi-word user-facing string in a .tsx return outside a t()/<Trans> call (the catalog-bypass — brain P9/O8) and a write of a non-${VAR} literal secret into .mcp.json. Fail-open on malformed/empty stdin; emits a cited message + non-zero exit on a real violation. The inherited protect-secrets.js is KEPT alongside it (it blocks credential files; this hook blocks hardcoded-string patterns).

install_instructions: 1. Install deps + build: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm build (so dist/mcp/server.js exists).  2. Add this plugin to Claude Code: Settings → Plugins → Add local plugin → select the parrot repo root.  3. The parrot CLI (`parrot --help`), the 9 MCP tools (parrot_init / parrot_extract / parrot_check / parrot_icu / parrot_rtl_audit / parrot_hreflang / parrot_pick / parrot_search_brain / parrot_explain) + the parrot://brain/* resources, the 6 skills, the 2 sub-agent personas (i18n-correctness-auditor, i18n-migration-planner), and the i18n-string-gate hook are now available; the parrot MCP server is wired via .mcp.json (TMS/MT creds as ${env-refs}, no live keys). HARD invariant (brain P29): parrot wires the i18n pipeline + grammar engine + routing + CI gate — it NEVER authors the words. It tests pl/ar/he, never English alone (brain O7/O23). mt/tms are advertised as plannedCapabilities in the A2A card until their cluster lands — the card never over-claims.
